course_name_original: UE Méthodes et outils pour la conception avancée
course_name_en: Methods and tools for advanced design
prerequisites: Comfort with C programming under Unix.

learning_outcomes.text: Organize code in a modular, readable, documented, evolvable, and reusable way.
Master the concepts of separate compilation and library creation/use, and know how to use associated tools.
Design and execute tests and evaluate their quality (coverage).
Master the detection of various types of design or programming flaws and errors, using methods such as symbolic execution, dynamic memory management analysis.
Understand the concept of vulnerability analysis and use appropriate tests.
Understand concepts related to performance analysis (efficiency of the code itself, impact of the executing hardware architecture) and know how to exploit tools for this analysis.

institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Informatique (UGA)
